What PDF metadata can reveal—and how to remove it

PaperVault · November 12, 2026 · 5 min read

PDF metadata is information associated with a file rather than text that necessarily appears on its pages. Before sharing a document, check both its visible content and its properties; removing metadata does not redact what a reader can see.

What can metadata include?

Depending on how a PDF was created and edited, its properties may include details such as an author name or other descriptive information. Some tools can also retain details associated with images or a document's editing history. The exact fields vary, so do not assume every PDF contains the same information—or that a quick visual review reveals everything stored in its properties.

Metadata is not the same as page content

Removing metadata is not the same as redacting a name, account number, signature, or comment that appears on a page. A black rectangle drawn over text may not remove the underlying text at all. If you need to permanently conceal sensitive visible information, use a dedicated redaction workflow and verify the resulting file. PaperVault's metadata tool should not be treated as a redaction tool.

Remove metadata from a PDF copy

  1. Keep the original file in case you need its properties later.
  2. Use a PDF app that explicitly offers metadata removal. PaperVault lists Strip Metadata and describes removing details such as author and location information.
  3. Save the cleaned result as a separate copy.
  4. Open the copy and review every page for visible information you still need to remove or protect.
  5. If metadata needs to be removed for a formal privacy or compliance requirement, verify the output with an appropriate inspection tool and follow your organization's process.

A short before-sharing checklist

  • Check the filename and document properties for information you did not intend to disclose.
  • Review visible pages, comments, attachments, and signatures separately from metadata.
  • Confirm the cleaned copy opens and still contains the information the recipient needs.
  • Use a trusted transfer method and send it only to the intended recipient.
PaperVault privacy: Its App Store listing says metadata removal is processed on-device. Read the privacy policy for the broader explanation of document processing and file-provider behavior.
